verdict.rationale: Modal's homepage states that H100, A100 and A10G GPUs are available on demand and can be attached to any sandbox, billed per second. The Sandbox SDK reference exposes a `gpu=` parameter on sandbox creation, alongside cpu, memory and region. A community builder also reports running GPU-native GitHub Actions runners on Modal Sandboxes, which corroborates that this works in practice. Missing for 10: a dedicated guide for configuring GPU sandboxes (GPU type strings, multi-GPU counts, availability limits) and detailed hands-on corroboration beyond one brief community mention.
